$comment: GENERATED by tools/canon/items.ts from canon/items.yaml and every chapter's `props` — do not edit. Canon is the source of truth (docs/canon-contract.md); run `npm run canon:items`.

brave_whistle.name: Brave Whistle
brave_whistle.text: One loud note. +2 on your next roll.

mosslight_jar.name: Mosslight Jar
mosslight_jar.text: Soft green light. +3 on your next roll.

thunder_acorn.name: Thunder Acorn
thunder_acorn.text: Throw it. It cracks like thunder. 3 damage.

luckstone.name: Luckstone
luckstone.text: Roll a 1? Roll it again. Once each fight.

charm_ford_witch.name: Mother Thrum's Tuned Charm
charm_ford_witch.text: A little bell charm tuned to the note the stones hum. Hold it near a gem and it sings.

facet_drakes_rate.name: The Drake's Rate
facet_drakes_rate.text: The newest piece on a river drake's hoard shelf. Marked PAID, underlined twice.

facet_ember.name: The Ember Facet
facet_ember.text: A red stone, warm as toast, that fell from the sky into an Exchange gutter by your boot.

facet_ford.name: The Ford Stone
facet_ford.text: A fist-sized gem wrapped in a witch's wool sock. It rings every bell charm it passes, and it will not stop.

facet_harvest.name: The Harvest Stone
facet_harvest.text: A green-gold stone from a sprites' corner row. It still wears a tiny medal: BEST.

hollow_crown_shard.name: Shard of the Hollow Crown
hollow_crown_shard.text: A curl of cold silver. It hums when you are close to the rest of it.

medal_not.name: A Very Small Woven Medal
medal_not.text: Woven by harvest sprites for leaving their stone alone. It says NOT.

ossley_debt_stone.name: Ossley's Wet Stone
ossley_debt_stone.text: A plain river stone that is always a little bit wet. Old Ossley's price: carry it up, put it down, and say thank you to the river.

ossley_reed_knot.name: Ossley's Reed Knot
ossley_reed_knot.text: A reed knot from Old Ossley. "Later. When I'm going your way." It never dries.

torn_map_east.name: Torn Map (East Half)
torn_map_east.text: Half a map, drawn in berry juice. Somebody has the other half.
